questions.text:
How many colours are
in a rainbow?
questions.fact: Red to violet, as Newton named them

questions.text: Water freezes at 0 °C
questions.say: True or false? Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius.
questions.fact: That's 32 °F at normal air pressure

questions.text:
How many legs does
a spider have?
questions.fact: Spiders aren't insects: insects have 6

questions.text: Which one is a mammal?
questions.fact: Whales breathe air and feed their young milk

questions.text:
What do giant pandas
mostly eat?
questions.fact: Bamboo is almost their whole diet|🎋

questions.text: Which has more legs?
questions.fact: 8 walking legs plus 2 claws = 10
questions.say_answer: The crab! Ten legs, counting its two claws.

questions.text:
Which ocean lies between
Africa and Australia?
questions.fact: The third-largest ocean on Earth

questions.text:
How many rings are on
the Olympic flag?
questions.fact: First flown at the 1920 Games

questions.text:
What's the capital
of Egypt?
questions.fact: Cairo sits on the River Nile

questions.text:
Sound travels faster in
water than in air
questions.say: True or false? Sound travels faster in water than in air.
questions.fact: Roughly 4 times faster

questions.text: Why are flamingos pink?
questions.fact: Pigments in the algae and shrimp they eat

questions.text: Chemical symbol for gold?
questions.say: What is the chemical symbol for gold?
questions.fact: From the Latin word 'aurum'

questions.text: Which is older?
questions.fact: Oxford taught by 1096; Tenochtitlan began in 1325
questions.say: Which is older: Oxford University, or the Aztec capital, Tenochtitlan?
questions.say_answer: Oxford! It was teaching students over 200 years earlier.

questions.text:
Longest bone in
the human body?
questions.say: What's the longest bone in the human body?
questions.fact: Your thigh bone: about a quarter of your height

questions.text:
Smallest country
in the world?
questions.say: What's the smallest country in the world?
questions.fact: Under half a square kilometre

questions.text:
How many keys on a
standard piano?
questions.fact: 52 white keys and 36 black

questions.text:
How many eyes does
a honeybee have?
questions.fact: 2 big compound eyes + 3 small ones on top

questions.text:
Most common gas in
the air we breathe?
questions.say: What's the most common gas in the air we breathe?
questions.fact: About 78% of air is nitrogen

questions.text:
Which letter is in no
chemical element symbol?
questions.say: Which letter doesn't appear in any chemical element symbol?
questions.fact: Q is the only other missing letter

questions.text:
Cleopatra lived closer
in time to…
questions.say: Cleopatra lived closer in time to which: the Moon landing, or the building of the Great Pyramid?
questions.fact: The pyramid was already about 2,500 years old

yt.title: 20-Question Challenge: How Far Can You Get? 🏆
yt.description:
Twenty brand-new questions that start easy and finish at expert: spider legs, piano keys, honeybee eyes and a Cleopatra timeline twist. Keep count and comment your score out of 20 👇
